title: Frontend Developer Intern
eligibility: Students pursuing B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or a related degree with basic web development experience.
description: Join a small, supportive product team building thoughtful tools for independent creators. You will ship real features, learn a modern frontend workflow, and get feedback from experienced engineers.
responsibilities: Build responsive product interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Work with designers and engineers to turn product ideas into polished features.
Test your work across browsers and improve usability and accessibility.

title: Python Software Intern
eligibility: Undergraduate or postgraduate students comfortable with Python fundamentals and curious about backend systems.
description: Help the OrbitStack platform team improve the APIs that power scheduling and operations software for growing businesses. Pair with a mentor and contribute to a live development cycle.
responsibilities: Implement and test API features in a Python web application.
Write clear, maintainable code and take part in code reviews.
Investigate bugs with the team and document useful solutions.

title: Data Science Intern
eligibility: Students in statistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related field; introductory Python and SQL knowledge is helpful.
description: Explore real product and customer datasets with a friendly analytics team. You will learn how good questions, careful data cleaning, and clear communication help teams make better decisions.
responsibilities: Clean and explore structured datasets using Python and SQL.
Create charts and concise summaries for internal stakeholders.
Collaborate with data scientists to validate findings.

title: Machine Learning Research Intern
eligibility: Students pursuing a degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline with introductory ML knowledge.
description: Work alongside applied researchers exploring practical machine learning for document understanding. This is a hands-on learning role with weekly research reviews and a dedicated mentor.
responsibilities: Prepare datasets and establish reproducible experiment baselines.
Evaluate model performance and communicate findings.
Read relevant research and help prototype promising approaches.

title: Product Design Intern
eligibility: Students or recent graduates interested in digital product design. A portfolio or class project is welcome.
description: Help make complex tasks feel simple. You will join designers working on approachable financial tools and learn how research, interaction design, and visual craft fit together.
responsibilities: Create wireframes, flows, and interactive prototypes in Figma.
Join research sessions and summarize user observations.
Help maintain components and documentation in the design system.

title: Security Operations Intern
eligibility: Students studying computer science, information security, or IT with foundational networking knowledge.
description: Learn from a security operations team that helps organizations stay resilient. The internship focuses on defensive security, careful investigation, and responsible reporting.
responsibilities: Assist with triaging security alerts in a supervised environment.
Research vulnerabilities and summarize defensive mitigations.
Help improve internal runbooks and security awareness materials.

title: Cloud Platform Intern
eligibility: Students pursuing engineering or computer science degrees with an interest in cloud infrastructure and automation.
description: Make cloud infrastructure easier to understand and operate. You will work with platform engineers, learn deployment fundamentals, and contribute to useful internal tooling.
responsibilities: Support improvements to deployment scripts and developer tooling.
Document cloud resources and operational workflows.
Learn to monitor services and investigate reliability issues.

title: Android App Developer Intern
eligibility: Students in computer science or a related program with basic programming experience and an interest in mobile apps.
description: Help a close-knit mobile team build a more delightful everyday planning app. Bring your curiosity, learn through pairing, and see your work reach real users.
responsibilities: Implement small Android interface improvements in Kotlin.
Connect app screens to existing APIs with guidance.
Test features on different screen sizes and report issues.

title: Applied AI Intern
eligibility: Students with Python fundamentals and an interest in responsible AI, language technology, and product experimentation.
description: Explore practical, human-centered AI features with a team that values careful evaluation. You will help prototype ideas and think critically about reliability and user experience.
responsibilities: Prototype language model workflows and supporting integrations.
Create evaluation examples and analyze output quality.
Document limitations and suggest responsible product improvements.

title: Software Engineering Intern
eligibility: Students pursuing B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or a related degree with a strong foundation in programming.
description: Build reliable software with a cross-functional team solving practical challenges for small businesses. Expect thoughtful code reviews, steady mentorship, and room to ask questions.
responsibilities: Develop and test small software features with your mentor.
Take part in planning, code reviews, and team demos.
Write documentation that helps teammates use your work.

title: Business Intelligence Intern
eligibility: Students in business, economics, statistics, or computer science who enjoy working with data and communicating insights.
description: Turn everyday business questions into clear, useful answers. Work with analysts to prepare reports and build confidence with data storytelling.
responsibilities: Assist with data validation and recurring reports.
Build simple dashboard views with analyst guidance.
Present findings in plain language for non-technical teammates.

title: Cloud Automation Intern
eligibility: Students pursuing computer science or engineering degrees who have tried scripting or cloud projects and are eager to learn.
description: Grow your cloud engineering skills by helping build safer, more repeatable infrastructure workflows. The team offers guided project work and regular one-on-one mentoring.
responsibilities: Help automate common cloud setup and maintenance tasks.
Update infrastructure documentation and example configurations.
Test changes in a sandbox and share clear implementation notes.
